extraction.Name: Albert Ecoffey
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want a patent to his land, but accepted it because he was told by the Superintendent that if he did not take it that the land would be sold for taxes
extraction.Recorded patent: Deponent further states that he had the patent recorded
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged the land to Charles Bates of Gordon, Nebr. for $800.00; gave Bates 160.00 acres to call the mortgage square and the other to Rpundy & Martin, of Wanblee, So. Dak. for $700.00
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: could not pay the taxes, but that he did not get what he thought the land was worth, that he thinks it was worth about $3200.00; I could not pay the mortgage so I gave Bates 160.00 acres to call the mortgage square
extraction.Occupation/Income: makes his living by common labor and his income for a year is about $600.00
extraction.NOTES: Mentally competent and in just fair health; has a wife and four children to support; document sworn July 15, 1929, County of Shannon, State of South Dakota; land thought to be worth about $3200.00 | ORIGINAL_TRIBE_VALUE: "Shannon County, South Dakota (Pine Ridge area)" (normalized 2026-04-28 to canonical 'Pine Ridge')
